headline.title: Distribution capacity is setting the pace
headline.text: The largest distributors are adding hubs, stores and automation at once, while loyalty programmes and rebuilt online stores show where the digital race is heading.

themes.description: New or expanded distribution centers, hubs and store networks to improve availability.
Distributors entering new towns, states or dealer networks.
Online stores, loyalty programmes and digital catalogs for workshops and consumers.
Events, training and programmes that deepen relationships with repair shops.

stories.title: opens 63 net new stores in the third quarter, reaching 6,758 locations
stories.summary: O'Reilly reported 63 net new stores in Q3 (54 in the US, 8 in Mexico, 1 in Canada) and 173 year to date, with no closures. It remains on track for 225–235 openings in 2026 and credits new-store performance and double-digit professional growth for its share gains.

stories.title: opens its first store in Richboro, Pennsylvania
stories.summary: Advance is opening a store on 2nd Street Pike in Richboro, Bucks County, its first in the town, with a ribbon cutting on 29 October. The opening includes a $1,000 donation to a local automotive technician programme.

stories.title: automates its flow-center fulfilment with a goods-to-person storage and retrieval system
stories.summary: Genuine Parts' NAPA has engaged Hy-Tek Intralogistics to deploy a Hai Robotics HaiPick system as part of a transformation of its flow-center operations. The system is meant to raise storage density, throughput and order accuracy and to scale with NAPA's growth.

stories.title: signs McDonald Automotive as its 29th dealer-group franchise, covering the Denver metro area
stories.summary: Mighty announced a franchise agreement with McDonald Automotive, a 13-dealership group in the Denver area, which will operate as McDonald Mighty from warehouse space at its Audi dealership in Parker, Colorado. Parts distribution comes in-house for the dealer group.

stories.title: expands its VIP Event Series to a two-day format in Houston, Dallas and Orlando
stories.summary: The 2026 series combined product training, supplier showcases, awards and customer trade shows for independent repair shops. Houston and Orlando moved to a two-day format, and Orlando marked the company's return to that market for the series.

stories.title: launches CarParts+ Rewards, its first points-based loyalty programme
stories.summary: Customers earn points on every dollar across a catalogue of more than 1.5 million parts, with a free tier and a $79-a-year Gold tier that bundles roadside assistance, free shipping and extended returns. Since a soft launch in September the programme has enrolled over 118,000 members.

stories.title: completes its US distribution-center buildout and targets 300 mega hubs within three years
stories.summary: On its fiscal Q4 call AutoZone said the US distribution expansion is complete, with two new distribution centers and two direct-import facilities. It opened 39 mega hubs in the year to reach 172, plans more than 40 in fiscal 2027, and keeps roughly $1.5 billion of annual capital on stores, hubs and mega hubs.

stories.title: opens three stores in Georgia, Massachusetts and Maryland, with the Athens site doubling as a market hub
stories.summary: Advance opened a fifth Athens, Georgia store that also operates as a market hub for same-day fulfilment to nearby stores, plus second stores in Randolph, Massachusetts and Lanham, Maryland. Each opening included a donation to a local automotive technology programme.

stories.title: relaunches its e-commerce site covering 1.8 million parts and 300 million vehicle applications
stories.summary: JEGS went live with a rebuilt digital commerce platform on PhaseZero, replacing a system that had run for more than two decades. It adds fitment-based search, live pricing and inventory, delivery estimates and more than 20 integrations, with AI-assisted commerce planned next.

stories.title: opens a 450,000 sq ft distribution center in Olive Branch, Mississippi, its first in the state
stories.summary: The Lake Success, New York distributor opened the hub near Memphis in a major logistics corridor, fully staffed from day one. It is meant to speed deliveries to commercial customers and repair shops nationwide and to broaden inventory across the network.

copy.stories_lead: New investments, product launches, market entries, channel expansion and competitive moves across the automotive aftermarket.

host_note.name: Julieta Vázquez
host_note.text: More part numbers do not automatically create more sales. The opportunity is knowing which applications have demand, where coverage gaps exist and how much inventory each category really needs. When that intelligence is connected to engineering and production, assortment becomes a growth tool.

Integrated production aligned with operational needs
Regional sourcing from Mexico and the U.S.
Product controls that support reliability and reduce returns

We work with your team to balance coverage, product reliability and inventory investment around the needs of your market.

offers.name: Improve Product Mix & Category Profitability

Identification of high-potential applications

Continuous category review through PARTNER

New applications for unmet repair needs

Products developed to specification

From individual applications to repair kits, we help convert unmet repair demand into differentiated commercial opportunities.

Assortment tailored to regional vehicle populations

Joint engineering and material development

Flexible scaling from development into production

Visibility across materials and manufacturing processes
